messages:
ashley: Heads-up — PM just confirmed the new 'Pro Plus' pricing tier goes live Monday. It includes a quota bump that could drive heavy churn-to-upgrade traffic. Need a quick GPU hours forecast and plan for queue/backpressure.

miguel: Preliminary spike model looks nasty — 1.8x median, 2.5x 75th, 3x tail in first 48h if trial incentives hit. Will run bucketed sims.

priya: Region note: eu-west has ~22 A100s free after current commits; APAC is tighter. If traffic rebalances toward EU we'll see queue formation within ~12h at 2x.

kai: Can we gate with temporary rate-limits on tier upgrade events instead of immediately provisioning more GPUs? That gives time to decide reserve vs burst.

ashley: Prefer rolling rate-limits + auto-burst. Miguel — can you run reserve vs on-demand delta for a 7-day surge and include region split implications?

miguel: On it. Quick back-of-envelope: baseline ~12k GPU-hours/week. If first-week demand doubles -> +12k GPUh. Rough prices: reserved commit = ~$2.60/GPUh (ballpark), on-demand = ~$5.00/GPUh. Code snippet I used for sim:

    # simulate weekly GPU-hours
    baseline = 12000
    surge_multiplier = 2.0
    surge_hours = baseline * (surge_multiplier - 1.0)

ops-bot: AUTO: fast-run complete for thread 1795004321 — projected 7-day peak GPU hours: 24,300 (+103%). Estimated on-demand cost (7d) = $54,600. Estimated 1-month reserved-equivalent cost to cover 7d peak = $31,200. Details: https://intra.redwood/ops/forecast/1795004321

priya: :warning: Even if overall capacity is covered, eu-west is a choke point. Reserved capacity is region-locked — if we put all reserve in us-west we'll still see EU queue/backpressure. Suggest splitting reserves and enabling cross-region burst routing.

kai: Operationally we can do 40% reserved commit (regional split) + 60% burst fallback and set temporary rate-limits on Pro upgrades. Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching pre-rollout to shave p95 tokens.

ashley: Decision (provisional): reserve 40% capacity split 60/40 us-west/eu-west, enable burst for first 72h, set a temporary rate-limit at ~1.5x baseline for Pro during the initial rollout window, and monitor p95 latency + queue depth. @miguel finalize numbers and upload to the ops doc by EOD. :calendar:

miguel: Will upload spreadsheet and a heatmap of per-region risk by 17:00 PST.

ops-bot: ALERT_RULES attached: monitor qdepth>50, p95-latency>600ms, gpu-util>85% in any region. Notifications -> #eng-oncall + oncall pager. :white_check_mark:
